target: Target D: Secure, Bounded Connectivity Probes
scenario_description: Network connectivity probes use validated HTTPS endpoints, enforce default TLS certificate verification, truncate response reads to 4KB, and detect captive portal interception.

probe_configuration.captive_portal_detection: Checks for HTTP redirects, HTML content-types, and login/portal/radius markers in sample body.

verification_results.captive_portal_interception: REJECTED (returns ProbeResult.success=False with Captive portal detected)
verification_results.tls_hostname_mismatch: REJECTED (raises ConnectError / SSLError, treated as failure)
